$comment: Permissions for eval runs, passed to `claude -p --settings`. Eval agents run unattended, so anything that prompts would hang the run. Rather than a blanket bypass, this grants exactly the tools the engineering skills need and denies network egress. Every run is confined to a throwaway sandbox directory that the runner creates and the agent is pointed at; the real repo is never the working directory. Web tools are denied so that a run cannot reach the live GitHub API or npm registry -- eval results have to be reproducible, and a skill that silently depends on the network would produce different grades on different days.
